entities.name: Layer 3 filtering
entities.description: Filtering procedure applied to measurement results from physical layer before using them for evaluation of reporting criteria or measurement reporting. Uses an exponential smoothing filter formula.

entities.name: Measurement result
entities.description: Latest received measurement result from the physical layer, denoted as M_n in the filtering formula.

entities.name: Filtered measurement result
entities.description: Updated filtered measurement result (F_n) used for evaluation of reporting criteria or measurement reporting.

entities.name: filterCoefficient
entities.description: Parameter k that determines the filtering characteristics, with a = 1/2^(k/4) in the filtering formula.

entities.name: Filter adaptation
entities.description: Adaptation of the filter to preserve time characteristics at different input rates, observing that filterCoefficient k assumes a sample rate equal to X ms.

entities.name: k = 0 condition
entities.description: If filterCoefficient k is set to 0, no layer 3 filtering is applicable.

entities.name: Logarithmic filtering condition
entities.description: Filtering is performed in the same domain as used for evaluation of reporting criteria or measurement reporting, i.e., logarithmic filtering for logarithmic measurements.
